definition: This dimension controls how and when player or enemy actions can interrupt other actions during combat. Variations include immediate interruptions, delayed responses, or conditional triggers based on specific events or actions.
exclusion_criteria: Real-time combat mechanics where actions occur simultaneously.
Turn-based systems that have no possibility of interruption.
inclusion_criteria: Players can interrupt enemy actions under certain conditions.
Enemies can interrupt player actions based on specific triggers.
title: Interrupt Mechanics in Turn-Based Combat
